description: One round room, glazed all the way round, the ceiling high at the centre and dropping to head height at the glass. Shelves radiate from a central core like spokes, holding the estate's papers in date order. Warm, quiet, smelling of paper.

window.description: The full circumference at first-floor height, and because the disc is thickest through the middle the glass leans out at the top, so standing at it you are looking slightly down at the pavement and slightly out from the building at the same time.
window.name: the lens glazing

name: Stamp Duty — The Records Office
